data.description: Enjoy a luxury lifestyle in a slice of paradise! Al Marjan Island not only provides an opulent retreat but also guarantees a smart investment for the future.

data.answer:
Al Marjan Island comprises four coral-shaped connected islets featuring a decent mix of hotels, resorts, and beachfront residences with high-end amenities.

Breeze Island

Closest to the Ras Al Khaimah coast, the islet has 2,000 meters of waterfront area. Breeze Island provides an exquisite blend of luxury and natural beauty, serving as the residence for some of the finest hotels in the area, including Rixos Bab Al Bahar, DoubleTree by Hilton, and Marjan Island Resort & Spa, managed by the Accor Hotel.

Treasure Island

The promenade is a major attraction for tourists and residents. Treasure Island has a kid's play area and a track to enjoy a healthy jog, a bicycle ride, or a quick run. Considered mainly a residential area built over 2.5 million sq. ft. of land, it features a 3,500-meter Corniche walkway and apartments offering breathtaking views of the sparkling water. 

Dream Island

The islet has 16,000 sq. ft. of waterfront land with mesmerizing golden beaches. It is connected to Treasure Island by the Marjan Island Boulevard bridge. The island will soon become home to Wynn Resort.

View Island

The island has the largest covered area among all four islands, which is 5 million sq. ft. It features magical beaches and desert dunes. Resorts, beachside hotels, and other luxury residences on View Island offer stunning views of the water and other parts of the community.

more_info.question: RAK Al Marjan Island Properties Insights

data.answer:
You can find a selection of apartments and hotel apartments for rent in Al Marjan Island, Ras Al Khaimah, and properties for sale. Pacific, Al Marjan Island Resort and Spa, and Bab Al Bahr are popular communities in the area.

Pacific is a six-tower apartment complex situated on View Island. The ten-floor structures in the complex are named Samoa, Tonga, Fiji, Tahiti, Polynesia, and Bora Bora. The development boasts diverse living spaces, including studios, 1-bed units, 2-bed suites, serviced apartments, and beach duplexes. There are also penthouses with plot sizes ranging from 3,510 sq. ft. to 3,512 sq. ft. The amenities include a swimming pool, Jacuzzi, sauna, steam room, health club, a play area for children, and ample parking facilities.

Marjan Island Resort and Spa is a resort that offers apartments for sale and rent. The lavish hotel apartments are available in studio and 1-bedroom layouts. These Marjan Island residences are unique, boasting two picturesque waterfronts and unparalleled amenities, including the exquisite La’Mar Spa.

Bab Al Bahr is on Breeze Island and is divided into two complexes: Rixos Bab Al Bahr and Bab Al Bahr Residences. Rixos Bab Al Bahr is a 5-star hotel that hosts luxury suites complemented by world-class service. The hotel comprises three pyramid-shaped buildings with a luxurious pool.

Meanwhile, Bab Al Bahr Residences is a residential part of the project with three pyramid-shaped buildings. This complex includes a variety of residential units, from studios and 1-bed to 2-bed and 3-bed apartments, as well as beachfront penthouses. Bab Al Bahr Residences also features a swimming pool and a paddling pool for children.

Olive Tree Residence and City Stay Beach Hotel are other popular hotels in Al Marjan Island that offer long-term accommodation.

Off-plan Projects In Al Marjan Island

The highly anticipated off-plan properties on Al Marjan Island are: 

  • Nikki Beach Residences, Aldar Properties
  • Rosso Bay Residences, Aldar Properties
  • Nobu Residences, H&H Development
  • Danah Bay, Dubai Investments
  • Oceano, The Luxe
  • Emaar Address Residences Al Marjan Residences, Emaar Properties
  • Moonstone by Durar Group

Renting A Property In Al Marjan Island

Many options are available when it comes to apartments for rent in Al Marjan Island.
You can find a studio flat starting at AED 23,000 annually, while a 1-bedroom unit is available for AED 37,990. The starting price of the 2-bed unit is AED 45,000, and the 3-BHK apartment is AED 85,000.

Buying A Property In Al Marjan Island

Those looking for investment opportunities can also find many options in the community. Studio units are available at a starting price of AED 399,999, while 1-bedroom apartments can be acquired for approximately AED 440,000. Investors interested in 2-bedroom flats on Al Marjan Island can explore options starting from AED 750,000, and 3-bedroom apartments are available with an average price of AED 1.65M.

To get a studio in the Pacific, you need around AED 341k for investment. The average sales prices ascend to AED 622k and AED 974k for 1-bedroom and 2-bedroom flats in the complex, respectively. If you want to buy a studio apartment in Bab Al Bahr Residences, the price will be around AED 331k. For 1 and 2-bedroom apartments, buyers must pay AED 646k and 1.1M, respectively. The studio flat in Al Marjan Island and Resort costs about AED 345k, and 1-BHK for AED 577k.

more_info.question: What's Life Like in Al Marjan Island?

data.answer:
Public Transportation in Al Marjan Island

There are limited public transport options to and from the island as the community is still in the developing phase. The nearest bus stop to Al Marjan is the RAK Bus Stop, 20 minutes from the district.

Want to go from Dubai to Al Marjan Island? If you want to use public transportation to reach Al Marjan Island, you can take a bus from Dubai International Airport to Ras Al Khaimah, and from there, Al Marjan Island is 20 minutes away. The route is known as DXB (T1 and T3).

Supermarkets in Al Marjan Island

There are a couple of supermarkets on Al Marjan Island. You can shop at Zoom, Bab Al Bahr, or Fresh Plus Grocery & Café (or Freshplus). Al Sanad Supermarket in Jazeerat Al Marjan is also a great option for grocery shopping. Also nearby is Al Hamra Mall, which houses Spinneys. It is a well-known supermarket chain operating primarily in the Middle East. It offers a diverse range of high-quality products, including fresh produce, groceries, household items, and more.

Shopping Malls In Al Marjan Island

The nearest mall for residents of Al Marjan Island is Al Hamra Mall. Spanning two levels, the mall accommodates approximately 130 local and international retail brands, a variety of dining choices, and engaging entertainment venues.
Additionally, visitors can find a healthcare facility, cinema, salons, and pharmacies within its premises.

Other notable malls in the emirate include RAK Mall and Manar Mall. These shopping centers are about a half-hour drive from the island.

Schools And Nurseries in Marjan Island

This development is in its early stages, and currently, there are no schools on Al Marjan Island. Educational institutions such as universities, colleges, and schools serving the area are in either Al Hamra Village or Al Hamra Industrial Area. The nearest schools to Al Marjan are Zainab School for Basic and Secondary Education, Al Jazeera Al Hamra Boys’ School for Basic & Secondary Education, Ras Al Khaimah Academy (also known as RAK Academy Al Hamra), and New British International School. The nearby nurseries include Red Bus Nursery, Little Treasures Nursery, and Al Hamra Nursery.

Churches, Temples and Mosques in Marjan Island

When it comes to places for worship, the mosques in proximity are Masjid Umar bin Al-Khathab and Al Iman Mosque. RAK Evangelical Church Center, St. Thomas Mar Thoma Church, and Seventh-day Adventist Church are the closest churches to the community.

Clinics and Hospitals in Marjan Island

Dr. Amina Al Amiri’s Clinic, RAK Medical Centre, Al Afia Medical Center, and Nexus Medical Clinic are medical facilities near Al Marjan Island. You can also access Sheikh Khalifa Specialty Hospital (SKSH), a 15-minute drive from Al Marjan Island.

Location and Nearby Areas

The popular areas near Al Marjan Island include Ras Al Khaimah City Center. The main city center of Ras Al Khaimah is located a short distance from Al Marjan Island. You can find shopping malls, markets, cultural attractions, and government offices here.

Al Hamra Village is a residential and leisure development near Al Marjan Island that houses residential communities, hotels, a golf course, and the Al Hamra Mall. Mina Al Arab is another waterfront development in Ras Al Khaimah, near Al Marjan Island. Mina al Arab features residential properties and pristine beaches. 

Major Roads and Highways

Al Marjan Island is conveniently connected to the rest of the UAE through several major roads and highways. The E11 (Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road) links the island to major cities like Dubai and Abu Dhabi, while the E311 (Sheikh Mohammed Bin Salem Road) provides direct access to Ras Al Khaimah and other northern emirates. Additionally, the E611 (Emirates Road) offers an alternative route for traveling between different emirates, bypassing the busier E11.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Marjan Island

data.answer:
Restaurants in Al Marjan Island Dubai

There are many dining options in Ras Al Khaimah. Ula is one of the popular high-end dining places in Al Marjan. Located in Movenpick Resort, the eatery features Mediterranean delights on the menu, like Woodfired Mix Grill, Chilean Sea Bass, and various rice, pasta, seafood, meat, and desserts.

There is also Zaitouna House at Al Marjan Island Resort and Spa. You can indulge in Lebanese, Arabian, and other Middle Eastern cuisines in this gorgeous restaurant. There is both indoor and outdoor seating available at the restaurant. Those who want to enjoy beautiful views of the glittering blue water and the surroundings can sit outside.

Another popular option for Labenese food is Meze, inside the DoubleTree by Hilton Resort and Spa. Residents and visitors can visit SALT to satisfy their fast food cravings or try Inferno at Al Marjan Island Resort and Spa for Italian delights. L’Olivo Restaurant is another excellent option in Al Marjan Island for trying Italian food. Situated at Rixos Bab Al Bahr, the restaurant also has an indoor seating area with a bar.

Are you on the hunt for a restaurant on Al Marjan Island that offers delectable seafood? Claw BBQ is your destination for mouthwatering shrimp dishes, salads, and much more. Some other popular restaurants on Al Marjan Island that residents and visitors love to visit are Sanchaya, Brasserie Restaurant and Seven Heights Restaurant.

Al Marjan Island Beaches

Al Marjan Island, a man-made archipelago in Ras Al Khaimah, is surrounded by beautiful coastal areas and beaches. Turtle Beach is a popular attraction in the community. Here, you can enjoy the coastal beauty and participate in water activities like skiing, parasailing, banana boat rides, kayaking, and paddleboarding.

Al Hamra Beach is another ideal spot for beach lovers near the community. The beach is near Al Hamra Village, providing a serene setting for relaxation and water activities. Al Jazeera Beach, situated nearby, is also great for those looking to enjoy the sun, sand, and sea.

Hotels in Al Marjan Island

Al Marjan Island in Ras Al Khaimah, UAE, is known for its hospitality and tourism developments, including luxury hotels and resorts. The Hilton Ras Al Khaimah Beach Resort is one of the notable hotels on or near Al Marjan Island. Located on the shores of Al Marjan Island, this upscale resort offers a range of amenities, including multiple dining options, swimming pools, and private beach access.

DoubleTree by Hilton Resort & Spa Al Marjan Island is another upscale hotel in Al Marjan Island. It provides a luxurious stay experience with various dining options, spa facilities, and family-friendly activities. The DoubleTree at Marjan Island presents an array of 13 dining and bar options, encompassing an expansive all-day buffet experience at Al Marjan restaurant. Also, there is a kids' club, an outdoor play area, and a water park.

Al Marjan Island Resort Ras Al Khaimah is positioned on Al Marjan Island and features well-appointed rooms, multiple dining venues, a spa, and a private beach. Moreover, there are lots of fun things to do for kids. They can play arcade games or have fun in the sun at the outdoor play area. A designated track for biking and cart riding along the beach also exists.

For those seeking a truly tranquil escape, the Lama Spa features saunas, jacuzzis, a well-equipped gym, and indoor pools for a rejuvenating time out.

 Located on Al Marjan Island Boulevard, Movenpick Resort Al Marjan Island provides visitors with many amenities. Enjoy a fun day at Floating Water Park or a relaxing spa day at Citrine Spa. Las Vegas' famed Wynn Resorts on Marjan Island is an upcoming attraction in Al Marjan that will feature super luxury rooms, lounges, restaurants, and the UAE’s biggest casino!

Rixos Bab Al Bahr and Hampton By Hilton Marjan Island are other popular resorts in the community that provide guests with fantastic accommodation options and leisure facilities.

The island is the entertainment and adventure facilities hub. Some of the top attractions on Al Marjan Island include Jebel Jais, Wadia Shawka, and Khatt Spring. Jebel Jais has become a notable destination for nature enthusiasts, adventure seekers, and those looking to experience the beauty of the UAE's mountainous terrain.

One of its highlights is Jebel Jais Flight - the world's longest zipline- and the Jebel Jais Viewing Deck Park, which offers breathtaking views. Wadi Shawka, on the other hand, is a seasonal watercourse in the Hajar Mountains and a popular destination for outdoor activities such as hiking, trekking, and mountain biking. The varied terrain and natural features make it an ideal location for adventure seekers.

Khatt Springs in Khatt, part of the Ras Al Khaimah emirate, is also a nearby attraction. It's located in the eastern part of the emirate, surrounded by the Hajar Mountains. The main attraction of Khatt Springs is the natural hot springs, which are believed to have therapeutic properties. The springs are known for their warm and mineral-rich waters.

RAK Corniche is a scenic waterfront area with parks and walking paths. The attraction close to Al Marjan provides beautiful views of the sea and is a popular spot for recreation.

Abundant in heritage, Ras Al Khaimah also boasts some of the nation's most breathtaking museums and cultural landmarks. Explore the RAK National Museum, Dhaya Fort, and Jazirat Al-Hamra to delve into the region's rich cultural tapestry. All these attractions are very close to Al Marjan Island.

Community Events and Activities

Al Marjan Island hosts a variety of community events and activities that create a vibrant and engaging atmosphere for residents and visitors. These include the annual Al Marjan Festival, which features cultural performances, food stalls, and family entertainment. Regular outdoor fitness classes such as yoga, pilates, and aerobics are held on the beach or in parks.

The Marjan Island Night Market offers local crafts, food, and entertainment weekly, while sports tournaments, including beach volleyball and water sports, occur throughout the year. The island also celebrates holidays with events like New Year's Eve fireworks and National Day parades, and hosts art and music festivals showcasing local and international talent. These events contribute to a lively community environment, making Al Marjan Island a desirable destination for living and visiting.

Before moving to Al Marjan, there are a few things that you need to consider, which include the lack of schools and nurseries. Still, as the community is rapidly growing, reputable educational institutes are expected to open their campuses in the near future. The lack of public transportation is something to be considered by investors and homebuyers.

You can visit Al Marjan Island Beach, RAK. Moreover, hotels like DoubleTree by Hilton Resort & Spa Marjan Island, Hampton by Hilton Marjan Island, and Rixos Bab Al Bahr offer easy access to a private beach.
